# SpectralTransition

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A qualitative change in the eigenvalue statistics of a many-body Hamiltonian, often from Poisson to Wigner-Dyson or vice versa, as a control parameter is varied. Maps to phase transitions in computational capacity and information propagation in iNEST reservoir architectures.
